_: The chains a calibration runs on: static facts only (fee model, read-only price and L1-fee inputs, fallback RPCs). Addresses equal the address registry (a gate checks it). Everything measured lives in <chainId>.json.

price.why: ETH is the same asset on every chain: one feed, read on Base (as razor does)
the gas token is USDC, the job token: no conversion, no price feed

policy_why.ethMoveBps: the gas token is the job token (USDC): no price can move between the quote and our legs
policy_why.tipPercentile: a zero tip sat unmined on Arc (2026-09-17) and the 75th-percentile tip is near zero; the 90th is what paying transactions use

price.why: ETH is the same asset on every chain: one feed, read on Base (as razor does)

143.name: Monad
143.gas_token_vol_why: the standard deviation of MON/USD hourly log returns over the 7 days to 2026-10-01 (Chainlink MON / USD on Monad, one round per hour): 0.0155, rounded up; over 16 days it reads 0.013

price.why: Chainlink's MON / USD feed on Monad itself (8 decimals, heartbeat 3,600 s): MON has no feed on Base

143.gas_charge: Monad charges the gas LIMIT a transaction sets, not the gas it uses: a sender that sets the limit at its estimate x 1.2 pays about that, which the provisional legs' +25 % covers

x402.why: sellers on Monad take x402 in USDC here; exact is EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization (the seller's facilitator sends it and pays its gas); upto settles through Permit2 and needs one approval from the payer
